title: Merging is the lead's, after the operator's review where that is a gate; pushing and opening a pull request are never gates
situation: Pushing needed the operator's say-so, and the operator's review of a pull request was not named as a point the merge waits on; the operator, signing off the sign-off-gates story, said pushing a branch or opening a pull request is not a gate.
decision: The lead merges each pull request that passes review and every check as its task ends; where the operator reviews it, only once the operator signs it off. The architect accepts the story on its outcome. Pushing a branch or opening a pull request is never a gate.
consequences: The lead and gate concepts state this; the development conventions follow.
